files.index.json: Lightweight list of all docs without content bodies.
files.catalog.json: Full catalog including content for every docs file.
files.documents.jsonl: Same documents as catalog, one JSON object per line.

document_fields.id: Stable id derived from path under docs/.
document_fields.related_source: Primary instagram/* source path(s), or null.
document_fields.content: Full UTF-8 text of the document (catalog.json / documents.jsonl only).
